Title: Azure SQL Managed Instance management pack is now generally available

Body.Content:
System Center Operations Manager (SCOM) management pack for Azure SQL Managed Instance is now generally available. Use the pack to build hybrid monitoring solutions for your existing on-premises and data center resources, along with monitoring SQL Managed Instances in the cloud. Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid monitoring of on-premises and cloud resources from a single place with your existing infrastructure and no additional investment.

With this release we've made significant updates and additions to the management pack enhancing your enterprise readiness. New features include automated discovery and configuration of SQL Managed Instances as well as a wider coverage of instance specific features, such as monitoring in-memory Online Transactional Processing (OLTP) and supporting SQL Server and Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) authentication, among others.

For more information, see Azure SQL Database Managed Instance Management Pack (7.0.22.0).
